title: Bespoke Nimble 9B via Ollama
slug_note: One command; under 100 ms per answer on an M5 Max MacBook Pro (Ollama page).

variation.quant_detail: Ollama's nimble:latest tag, 9.3 GB (q4_K_M 5.6 GB and bf16 18 GB tags also exist)

requirements.notes: Estimate: 9.3 GB tag plus runtime. The nimble:9b-q4_K_M tag (5.6 GB) is the smaller option.

steps.text: Install Ollama (see Step 0 in Quick start).
Send decision requests to http://localhost:11434/v1/systemone with model "nimble"; up to 64 questions per request.

caveats: Decision model: it answers typed questions with probabilities on /v1/systemone; it does not chat, so OpenCode and chat UIs cannot use it.
Every question's prompt must fit Nimble's 8,192-token context (Ollama page).
